text: The boiling point of water at standard atmospheric pressure is 100°C.
Paris is the capital city of France.
The human heart typically has four chambers.
One of the oldest known non-clonal organisms on Earth is a Bristlecone Pine named Methuselah, which is over 4,800 years old.
Mount Everest's official height, as measured by China and Nepal in 2020, is 8,848.86 meters above sea level.
Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the moon in 1969, making him the only American astronaut to do so during the Apollo program.
While Thomas Edison is often credited, the very first electric light bulb was invented by Humphry Davy decades before Edison's commercially successful version.
Pluto's reclassification as a dwarf planet in 2006 was universally accepted by the scientific community and ended all debate about its planetary status.
Napoleon Bonaparte suffered from a medical condition that caused him to be significantly shorter than the average European man of his time, which is the origin of the 'Napoleon complex' term.
